. ( aey payghumber ! ) Allah ney uss aurat ki baat sunn li hai jo tum say apney shohar kay baaray mein behas ker rahi hai , aur Allah say fariyad kerti jati hai .   aur Allah tum dono ki guftoogo sunn raha hai . yaqeenan Allah sabb kuch sunney dekhney wala hai .

tum mein say jo log apni biwiyon say zihar kertay hain , ( unn kay iss amal say ) woh biwiyan unn ki mayen nahi hojaten . unn ki mayen to wohi hain jinhon ney unn ko janam diya hai . haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh log aesi baat kehtay hain jo boht buri hai , aur jhoot hai ,   aur Allah boht moaaf kernay wala , boht bakhshney wala hai .

aur jo log apni biwiyon say zihar kertay hain , phir unhon ney jo kuch kaha hai , uss say rujoo kertay hain , to unn kay zimmay aik ghulam azad kerna hai , qabal iss kay kay woh ( miyan biwi ) aik doosray ko haath lagayen .   yeh hai woh baat jiss ki tumhen naseehat ki jarahi hai , aur jo kuch tum kertay ho , Allah uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .

phir jiss shaks ko ghulam moyassar naa ho , uss kay zimmay do mutawatir maheenon kay rozay hain , qabal iss kay kay woh ( miyan biwi ) aik doosray ko haath lagayen . phir jiss ko iss ki bhi istataat naa ho , uss kay zimmay saat miskeeno ko khana khilana hai . yeh iss liye takay tum Allah aur uss kay Rasool per emaan lao . aur yeh Allah ki muqarrar ki hoi haden hain , aur kafiron kay liye dardnak azab hai .

yaqeen rakho kay jo log Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki mukhalifat kertay hain , woh aesay hi zaleel hon gay jaisay inn say pehlay log zaleel huye thay , aur hum ney khuli khuli aayaten nazil kerdi hain , aur kafiron kay liye aisa azab hai jo khuwar ker kay rakh dey ga ,

uss din jab Allah unn sabb ko dobara zinda keray ga , phir unhen bataye ga kay unhon ney kiya kuch kiya tha . Allah ney ussay ginn ginn ker mehfooz rakha hai , aur yeh ussay bhool gaye hain . aur Allah her cheez ka gawah hai .

kiya tum ney nahi dekha kay aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai , Allah ussay janta hai ? kabhi teen aadmiyon mein koi sargoshi aesi nahi hoti jiss mein chotha woh naa ho , aur naa paanch aadmiyon ki koi sargoshi aesi hoti hai jiss mein chata woh naa ho , aur chahye sargoshi kernay walay iss say kam hun ya ziyada , woh jahan bhi hon , Allah unn kay sath hota hai .   phir woh qayamat kay din unhen bataye ga kay unhon ney kiya kuch kiya tha . beyshak Allah her cheez ko janney wala hai .

kiya tum ney unn logon  ko nahi dekha jinhen sargoshi kernay say mana kerdiya gaya tha , phir bhi woh wohi kaam kertay hain jiss say unhen mana kiya gaya tha-? aur woh aik doosray kay sath aesi sargoshiyan kertay hain jo gunah , ziyadti aur Rasool ki nafarmani per mushtamil hoti hain . aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jab woh tumharay paas aatay hain to tumhen aesay tareeqay say salam kertay hain jiss say Allah ney tumhen salam nahi kiya ,   aur apney dilon mein kehtay hain kay :  hum jo kuch keh rahey hain , uss per Allah hamen saza kiyon nahi dey deta-?    jahannum hi unn ( ki khabar lenay ) kay liye kafi hai , woh ussi mein jaa phonchen gay , aur woh phonchney ki boht buri jagah hai .

aey emaan walo ! jab tum aapas mein aik doosray say sargoshi kero to aesi sargoshi naa kero jo gunah , ziyadti aur Rasool ki nafarmani per mushtamil ho , haan aesi sargoshi kero jo naik kamon aur taqwa per mushtamil ho , aur Allah say dartay raho , jiss kay paas tum sabb ko jama ker kay ley jaya jaye ga .

aesi sargoshi to shetan ki taraf say hoti hai , takay woh emaan walon ko ghum mein mubtala keray , aur woh Allah kay hukum kay baghair unhen zara bhi nuqsan nahi phoncha sakta . aur mominon ko Allah hi per bharosa rakhna chahiye .

aey emaan walo ! jab tum say kaha jaye kay majlison mein doosron kay liye gunjaeesh peda kero , to gunjaeesh peda kerdiya kero ,   Allah tumharay liye wusat peda keray ga , aur jab kaha jaye kay uth jao , to uth jao , tum mein say jo log emaan laye hain , aur jinn ko ilm ata kiya gaya hai , Allah unn ko darjon mein buland keray ga . aur jo kuch tum kertay ho , Allah uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .

aey emaan walo ! jab tum Rasool say tanhai mein koi baat kerna chahao to apni uss tanhai ki baat say pehlay kuch sadqa kerdiya kero .   yeh tareeqa tumharay haq mein behtar aur ziyada suthra tareeqa hai . haan agar tumharay paas ( sadqa kernay kay liye ) kuch naa ho to Allah boht bakhshney wala , boht meharban hai .

kiya tum iss baat say darr gaye kay apni tanhai ki baat say pehlay sadqaat diya kero-? abb jabkay tum aisa nahi ker-sakay , aur Allah ney tumhen moaaf kerdiya to tum namaz qaeem kertay raho , aur zakat detay raho , aur Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki farmanbardaari kertay raho .   aur jo kaam bhi tum kertay ho , Allah uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .

kiya tum ney unn ko nahi dekha jinhon ney aesay logon  ko dost banaya huwa hai jinn per Allah ka ghazab hai-?   yeh naa to tumharay hain , aur naa unn kay , aur yeh jantay boojhtay jhooti baaton per qasmen kha jatay hain .
Allah ney inn kay liye sakht azab tayyar ker rakha hai . haqeeqat yeh hai kay boht buray hain woh kaam jo yeh kertay rahey hain .
enhon ney apni qasmon ko aik dhaal bana liya hai ,   phir woh doosron ko Allah kay raastay say roktay rahey hain . iss liye inn kay liye aisa azab hai jo zaleel ker kay rakh dey ga .
inn kay maal aur inn ki aulad Allah kay muqablay mein inn kay kuch kaam nahi ayen gay . yeh dozakh walay log hain . yeh hamesha ussi mein rahen gay .

jiss din Allah inn sabb ko dobara zinda keray ga to uss kay samney bhi yeh ussi tarah qasmen khayen gay jaisay tumharay samney khatay hain , aur yeh samjhen gay kay enhen koi sahara mil gaya hai . yaad rakho yeh log bilkul jhootay hain .
inn per shetan ney poori tarah qabza jama ker enhen Allah ki yaad say ghafil kerdiya hai . yeh shetan ka giroh hai . yaad rakho shetan ka giroh hi na-murad honey wala hai .
beyshak jo log Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki mukhalifat kertay hain , woh zaleel tareen logon  mein shamil hain .
Allah ney yeh baat likh di hai kay mein aur meray payghumber zaroor ghalib ayen gay . yaqeen rakho kay Allah bari quooat wala , baray iqtidar wala hai .

jo log Allah aur aakhirat kay din per emaan rakhtay hain , unn ko tum aisa nahi pao gay kay woh unn say dosti rakhtay hon jinhon ney Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki mukhalifat ki hai , chahye woh unn kay baap hon , ya unn kay betay ya unn kay bhai ya unn kay khandan walay .   yeh woh log hain jinn kay dilon mein Allah ney emaan naqsh kerdiya hai , aur apni rooh say unn ki madad ki hai , aur unhen woh aesay baaghon mein dakhil keray ga jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi , jahan woh hamesha rahen gay . Allah unn say razi hogaya hai , aur woh Allah say razi hogaye hain . yeh Allah ka giroh hai . yaad rakho kay Allah ka giroh hi falah paaney wala hai .
